# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No code changes were required in this apply-fixes cycle. The prior review returned `approved` with no follow-up amendments, so I left the shrimp-routing implementation untouched and revalidated the relevant suites plus the current `tank_core` full-suite state.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the cycle-2 review output and current bead/worktree state to confirm there were no requested follow-up amendments for the shrimp feeding loop.
2. [Skipped] Skipped code edits because the review outcome was approved and no additional fixes were requested in this cycle.
3. [Completed] Re-ran the shrimp-routing and preset/materialization validation suites, then checked the current full `tank_core` suite status to capture any remaining unrelated failures.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed (17 tests total).
- `cargo test -p tank_data` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` was re-run; all exercised suites passed except the unrelated pre-existing failure in `crates/tank_core/tests/substrate_filter_integration.rs::filter_enabled_vs_disabled`.

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core` still fails on the pre-existing unrelated `crates/tank_core/tests/substrate_filter_integration.rs::filter_enabled_vs_disabled` regression (`filtered=1.772 mg/L`, `disabled=1.709 mg/L`).
- The worktree still contains an untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory that was left untouched.
